claims.claim: Of the 10 config-ranked candidates, 5 are weak even within their own zone; 5 only look weak because of where they stand.
claims.calculation: zone_score = 0.6(1 - pct_zone(theo/hr / config median)) + 0.4(1 - pct_zone(occupancy)); machine-specific if in the weakest 20% of its zone
claims.alt: All ten are simply in a quiet zone (location)
claims.test: Re-ranked every machine against its own zone; half stay near the bottom
claims.limit: The 20% cut-off and 0.6/0.4 weights are judgement calls; dominant zone used for machines that moved

claims.claim: The candidates' low results are not bad luck.
claims.result: Payout z-scores of the 10 candidates range -0.06 to +2.23; none below -2.58
claims.calculation: z = (house_win/coin_in - theo/coin_in) / sqrt(payout_multiplier_variance x bet_mix_factor / paid_spins)
claims.query: machine totals of coin_in_usd, theo_usd, house_win_usd, paid_spins JOIN game_math ON config_id
claims.alt: High-volatility variance hid a weak machine
claims.test: Variance-scaled z-score per machine using the game's own payout variance
claims.limit: Bet sizes per spin are not in the data; an equal mix of the listed bets is assumed (more conservative than equal bets)

claims.claim: M-1158 paid out significantly more than its configuration allows: a lead to inspect, not proof of a fault.
claims.result: Hold 3.04% vs expected 10.00%; z = -4.62 (flag 3.77 after correcting for 310 machines); below theo in 6 of 6 months; 1 machine(s) flagged in total
claims.calculation: Bonferroni two-sided 5% threshold across 310 machines; months below theo vs Binomial(n, 0.5)
claims.query: machine_month: house_win < theo per month; totals JOIN game_math
claims.alt: An unlucky streak on a medium-volatility game
claims.test: Shortfall exceeds the multiple-testing threshold and persists across months
claims.limit: Statistical evidence only; an inspection must confirm. No wrongdoing is implied

claims.claim: The W-ENT-B40 walkway closure (2025-03-03 to 2025-04-06) coincides with Back Forty's steepest drop, and the zone has not fully recovered since it reopened.
claims.result: Coin-in/day -29.4% during and -7.8% after vs the 35 days before; net of the rest of the floor -32.9 pp during, -6.7 pp after; entries/hr -30.4% during
claims.calculation: Equal 5-week windows (same weekday mix); difference-in-differences = zone % change - rest-of-floor % change
claims.query: floor_walkways closed_from/closed_to -> gaming dates; prepared_daily_view + zone_traffic_hourly by zone x window
claims.alt: Citywide seasonality or events (March tournament, CinemaCon, NAB)
claims.test: Difference-in-differences nets out swings that hit every zone
claims.limit: Closure timing is the only change tested; traffic counts are entries, not visitors

claims.claim: Center Pit gained while the walkway was closed, and kept the gain after it reopened.
claims.result: Center Pit coin-in/day +8.7% during, +11.3% after (net of the rest of the floor +12.1 / +18.0 pp)
claims.calculation: Same windows and difference-in-differences as above
claims.alt: Center Pit was already growing before the closure
claims.test: Monthly trend shown on the page; gain concentrated from March
claims.limit: Consistent with displaced players, but individual routes are not observed

claims.claim: Downtime and lost play are measured consistently from two independent sources.
claims.result: 5,021.08 h downtime (1,226 tickets, 1,207 fault repairs); estimated fault exposure $88,346.72
claims.calculation: downtime = available_at - opened_at (UTC); exposure = fault downtime x machine theo per available hour
claims.query: operations durations; prepared_daily_view scheduled - available hours on active days
claims.alt: Players switch to a nearby machine
claims.limit: Average play rate assumed; not actual lost revenue

claims.claim: Ridgeline machines are the main source of repairs.
claims.result: Ridgeline 7.23, Northwind 3.02, Halcyon 1.93 tickets per machine
claims.query: operations JOIN machines ON machine_id GROUP BY manufacturer
claims.alt: Ridgeline machines are older or busier

claims.claim: Tracked players' net result and its concentration.
claims.result: Wagered $163,804,869.65, paid $148,219,409.05, casino net $15,585,460.60; top 5% of losers = 40.73% of gross losses; wagering Gini 0.7536
claims.calculation: casino net = sum coin-in - sum payout; Gini over per-player totals
claims.alt: A few lucky or unlucky sessions
claims.test: Results shown for every month range

claims.claim: Points charged per comp dollar halved on May 1 in every tier.
claims.result: Base 15.0 -> 7.0; Gold 12.0 -> 5.6; Platinum 9.0 -> 4.2; comp cost $190,669.30 reconciles across three sources
claims.query: loyalty_ledger[event_type = redeem] by gaming date and tier
claims.test: Every tier halved on the same day
claims.limit: No policy record; cause not attributed

claims.claim: The calendar model forecasts slightly better than a weekday average, but does not change the July schedule.
claims.result: Holdout MAE $65,187 vs weekday $68,699 vs mean $218,258; gain 95% CI -$4,530 to $16,591; same quiet days as the baseline: True
claims.calculation: Train Jan 1-Apr 30, frozen; holdout May 1-Jun 30; 7-day moving-block bootstrap of the MAE gain

claims.claim: The forecast decides how each action is measured: floor-level effects of these actions would be invisible.
claims.result: Detection limit over 20 days ~1.07% of floor coin-in; best-case signage effect 0.75% -> measure at zone level against other zones
claims.calculation: detection limit = MAE / sqrt(days) / mean daily coin-in
claims.alt: Measure everything against total floor coin-in
claims.test: Compared each effect with the forecast's error

claims.claim: Inspecting 5 machines breaks even if 37% of their combined shortfall is real.
claims.result: low: net -$6,165; base: net -$371; high: net $10,367
claims.calculation: benefit = sum(daily shortfall) x operating days; cost includes inspection downtime at each machine's theo/hr
claims.query: Q1 payout test, 5 lowest z on the floor on Jun 30
claims.limit: Correction assumed to restore configured hold at once

claims.claim: Signage for Back Forty breaks even at 38% recovery of the gap left after the walkway reopened.
claims.result: Remaining gap $986 theo/day; low: net -$7,500; base: net $2,363; high: net $12,226
claims.calculation: gap = -DiD(after) x pre-closure theo/day; benefit = gap x recovery x operating days
claims.test: Measured against other zones over the same days
claims.limit: Signage effect size unknown; theo, not profit

claims.claim: The comp pilot does not pay back within 30 days; it is funded for the decision it informs.
claims.result: In-horizon savings at most $1,207 vs $4,000; the pricing decision is worth up to $34,762/year
claims.calculation: savings = (May-Jun - Jan-Apr monthly comp cost) x treatment share x days/30
claims.test: A floor-wide change cannot separate pricing from seasonality
claims.limit: 25 days may be too short to see visit changes

claims.claim: An extra technician is not funded: it cannot recover its cost.
claims.result: Waiting time is 27.9% of fault downtime -> at most $4,089 per 30 days vs $11,520
claims.calculation: max recovery = fault exposure per 30 days x response share
claims.test: Upper bound assumes all waiting is removed
